state_definition.packet_event_is_contended_if: median received delay exceeds threshold or any intended probe receiver misses the broadcast
state_definition.state_scope: one shared state per transmitter broadcast across all intended probe receivers

development_history: G3-B1 failed the light/moderate p95-delay gates because its packetwise unconditional delay draws could not represent sparse common contention events. G3-B2 is frozen before reading seeds 16-25.
claim_boundary: The two-state adapter is limited to the frozen eight-vehicle, 200-byte, 10-Hz IEEE 802.11p calibration regimes and is not a universal V2X channel model.
